text: The purpose of this report is to recommend that Toronto and East York Community Council appoint directors to the Forest Hill Village, Queen Street West and Upper Village BIA Boards of Management and remove directors from the Forest Hill Village and Queen Street West BIA Boards of Management.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. In accordance with the City's Public Appointments Policy, appointed the following nominees to the Business Improvement Area (BIA) Boards of Management set out below at the pleasure of Toronto and East York Community Council, and for a term expiring at the end of the term of Council or as soon thereafter as successors are appointed: Forest Hill Village: Zhou, Hang Queen Street West: Hughes, Gene Leitner, Nathan Upper Village: Lewis, Jonathon Elliott 2. Remove the following directors from the Business Improvement Area (BIA) Boards of Management set out below: Forest Hill Village: Amos, Solomon Leslieville: Malloy, Allen Queen Street West: Nguyen, William
